dilemma:

One of his players, Mike, is struggling with his performance and needs extra practice, but John is unable to provide the necessary time due to his job commitments. Should John sacrifice his personal time to help Mike improve or should he continue prioritizing his own job and personal life?

Give a clear recommendation and explain your reasoning.
